label: Blood collection date
notes: REDCap form blood_exams uses 'Datum odvzema' (collection date).

label: Leukocytes count
notes: Adult reference 4.0-11.0; lower in lymphopenia, higher in inflammation/infection.

label: Neutrophil absolute count
notes: Differential not in REDCap blood_exams form. Reference 1.8-7.5.

label: HbA1c
notes: IFCC unit. Derived from hba1c_b via 10.93*pct - 23.5.

label: Serum creatinine
notes: Reference F 50-90; M 60-110. Elevated in renal impairment.

label: HDL cholesterol
notes: Higher is protective; F ≥1.3 desirable; M ≥1.0 desirable.
